description: Cam Cavitt has been a realtor for nearly two decades, runs a small business, serves his Northeast Michigan community as County Drain Commissioner. Cam is currently running for State Representative as a conservative Republican who will fight for the rights of all Michiganders and the Northern Michigan way of life.
